title: What If AI Carried Her Imagination? Black Girls as Creators in an AI Storytelling Weekend Program
abstract: arXiv:2608.16896v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents the design and outcomes of a seven-weekend AI storytelling program developed for Black girls aged 10-12. Grounded in Afrofuturism and Black feminist thought, the program adopted AI-enabled counter-storytelling, supported the development of foundational AI literacies, and fostered future-oriented imagination. Activities included brainstorming AI-related topics, developing character and story plots, and delivering collaborative group presentations. Drawing on the analysis of learners' artifacts from the case study, findings show that participants created Afrofuturist narratives rooted in their identities and everyday experiences. At the same time, they developed core AI literacies, including prompt engineering, bias critique, and awareness of data privacy. translated_title: 如果人工智能承载了她的想象？黑人女孩在AI故事创作周末项目中的创作者身份
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了一项为10至12岁黑人女孩设计的为期七个周末的AI故事创作项目的设计与成果。该项目以非洲未来主义和黑人女性主义思想为基础，采用AI辅助的反叙事方式，支持基础AI素养的培养，并激发面向未来的想象力。活动包括头脑风暴AI相关主题、开发角色和故事情节，以及进行协作小组展示。通过对案例研究中学习者作品的剖析，研究结果显示，参与者创作了根植于自身身份和日常经验的非洲未来主义叙事。同时，她们也发展了核心AI素养，包括提示工程、偏见批判和数据隐私意识。该项目表明，在非正式学习空间中，将非洲未来主义叙事与生成式AI相结合，可以成为吸引黑人女孩参与的有效途径。
tldr: 该论文展示了将非洲未来主义叙事与生成式AI结合的非正式学习项目，如何帮助黑人女孩发展AI素养并创作根植于自身身份和经验的未来导向叙事。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates how integrating Afrofuturist storytelling with generative AI in informal learning spaces helped Black girls develop AI literacies and create future-oriented narratives rooted in their identities and experiences.
